mapper.insert: INSERT INTO piggy_banks (wallet_id, name, target_amount) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{name}, #{targetAmount})
mapper.update: UPDATE piggy_banks SET status = 'CANCEL', canceled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, wallet_id, name, target_amount, balance, bonus_type, bonus_value, status, is_favorite, first_deposited_at, target_reached_at, achieved_at, bonus_paid_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM piggy_banks WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE piggy_banks SET bonus_type = #{bonusType}, bonus_value = #{bonusValue}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE piggy_banks SET bonus_paid_at = #{bonusPaidAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE piggy_banks SET balance = #{balance}, status = #{status}, first_deposited_at = #{firstDepositedAt}, target_reached_at = #{targetReachedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
